title: Action-BED: Task-Driven Bayesian Experimental Design with Singly Intractable Objectives
abstract: arXiv:2606.23662v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Bayesian experimental design (BED) has traditionally been based on maximising expected uncertainty reductions from prior to posterior. A major shortfall of this approach is that it leads to doubly intractable objectives that are difficult to optimise, while customising them to particular downstream tasks of interest can also be difficult. Following first principles decision theory, we demonstrate that BED can alternatively be formulated in terms of an expected future loss (EFL) on downstream actions, providing a simple and naturally task-driven framework. Critically, we then show that all such EFLs can be rearranged into singly intractable objectives that can be jointly optimised with respect to both the design policy and a downstream action policy using stochastic gradients, an approach we refer to as ACTION-BED. translated_title: Action-BED：基于单重不可解目标的任务驱动贝叶斯实验设计
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯实验设计（BED）传统上基于最大化从先验到后验的期望不确定性缩减。这种方法的一个主要缺陷在于它会产生难以优化的双重不可解目标，而且针对特定的下游任务进行定制也十分困难。基于第一性原理的决策理论，我们证明了贝叶斯实验设计可以转而用下游动作的期望未来损失（EFL）来表述，从而提供了一个简单且天然任务驱动的框架。关键的是，我们随后证明所有此类EFL都可以重新整理为单重不可解目标，并可以利用随机梯度同时就设计策略和下游动作策略进行联合优化，我们将这一方法称为ACTION-BED。这一表述还避免了对任何显式后验或边缘似然估计的需求，并且天然……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ACTION-BED框架，通过以下游动作的期望未来损失重新表述贝叶斯实验设计，将其转化为可用随机梯度对设计策略和动作策略进行联合优化的单重不可解目标，从而无需显式的后验或边缘似然估计。
en_tdlr: ACTION-BED reformulates Bayesian experimental design in terms of expected future loss on downstream actions, converting it into singly intractable objectives that can be jointly optimized via stochastic gradients for both design and action policies, without requiring explicit posterior or marginal likelihood estimation.
